description: 语义枚举定义，面向开发者；数值对应 API 请求参数，Description 对应 UI 展示文本

enums.name: GameMode
enums.description: 游戏模式（天选/匹配/天人 × 单双三排 + 娱乐），值对应 /api/record/mini-program/stats 的 gameMode 参数

enums.name: GameModeCategory
enums.description: 模式大类（排位/匹配/娱乐/天人），不区分队伍人数

DataSource.name: FromApiString

parameters.name: apiValue
parameters.description: API 返回的 dataSource 字符串，如 "miniProgram" / "heyBox"

DataSource.description: 把 API 返回的 dataSource 字符串映射为 DataSource 枚举值，未识别时回退到 MiniProgram
DataSource.returns: 对应的 DataSource 枚举值
DataSource.body: return apiValue?.ToLowerInvariant() switch { "heybox" => DataSource.HeyBox, "dashen" => DataSource.DaShen, "miniprogram" => DataSource.MiniProgram, _ => DataSource.MiniProgram };

DataSource.name: ToApiString
DataSource.description: 把 DataSource 枚举值转为 unified 接口的 source query 参数字符串
DataSource.returns: API 识别的 source 字符串（miniProgram / heyBox / dashen）

GameMode.name: GetCategory
GameMode.description: 获取 GameMode 对应的大类（天选/匹配/天人/娱乐）
GameMode.body: return value switch { GameMode.RankSolo or GameMode.RankDuo or GameMode.RankTrio => GameModeCategory.Rank, GameMode.MatchSolo or GameMode.MatchDuo or GameMode.MatchTrio => GameModeCategory.Match, GameMode.TianrenSolo or GameMode.TianrenDuo or GameMode.TianrenTrio => GameModeCategory.Tianren, GameMode.EndlessTrial or GameMode.LandBattle => GameModeCategory.Fun, _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value)) };

GameMode.name: GetTeamSize
GameMode.description: 获取 GameMode 对应的队伍人数（单排/双排/三排）
GameMode.body: return value switch { GameMode.RankSolo or GameMode.MatchSolo or GameMode.TianrenSolo => TeamSize.Solo, GameMode.RankDuo or GameMode.MatchDuo or GameMode.TianrenDuo => TeamSize.Duo, GameMode.RankTrio or GameMode.MatchTrio or GameMode.TianrenTrio or GameMode.LandBattle => TeamSize.Trio, _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value)) };

GameMode.name: FromCategoryAndTeamSize

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: 模式大类：天选/匹配/天人

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: 队伍人数：单排/双排/三排

GameMode.description: 通过模式大类与队伍人数组合为具体的 GameMode 枚举值
GameMode.returns: 组合后的 GameMode 枚举值，如 RankTrio、MatchSolo 等
GameMode.body: return (category, size) switch { (GameModeCategory.Rank, TeamSize.Solo) => GameMode.RankSolo, (GameModeCategory.Rank, TeamSize.Duo) => GameMode.RankDuo, (GameModeCategory.Rank, TeamSize.Trio) => GameMode.RankTrio, (GameModeCategory.Match, TeamSize.Solo) => GameMode.MatchSolo, (GameModeCategory.Match, TeamSize.Duo) => GameMode.MatchDuo, (GameModeCategory.Match, TeamSize.Trio) => GameMode.MatchTrio, (GameModeCategory.Tianren, TeamSize.Solo) => GameMode.TianrenSolo, (GameModeCategory.Tianren, TeamSize.Duo) => GameMode.TianrenDuo, (GameModeCategory.Tianren, TeamSize.Trio) => GameMode.TianrenTrio, _ => throw new ArgumentException($"未知组合: {category} + {size}") };

GameMode.name: IsRankMode
GameMode.description: 判断 GameMode 是否属于天选排位模式
GameMode.returns: 如果是天选排位模式则返回 true
GameMode.body: return value switch { GameMode.RankSolo or GameMode.RankDuo or GameMode.RankTrio => true, _ => false };

GameMode.name: FromHeyBoxBattleTid

parameters.name: battleTid
parameters.description: heyBox 数据源对局的 battleTid（来自 /record/game-modes?dataSource=heyBox 的权威映射，值域与 miniProgram 的 battleApiCode 不同：天选单排=5000000、天选三排=5000001）

GameMode.description: 把 heyBox 数据源的 battleTid 映射为 GameMode 枚举值。heyBox 的 battleTid 与 miniProgram 的 battleApiCode 仅在天选单排/三排上不同，其余相同。
GameMode.returns: 对应的 GameMode 枚举值
GameMode.body: return battleTid switch { 5000000 => GameMode.RankSolo, 12 => GameMode.RankDuo, 5000001 => GameMode.RankTrio, 6 => GameMode.MatchSolo, 9 => GameMode.MatchDuo, 7 => GameMode.MatchTrio, 4 => GameMode.TianrenSolo, 13 => GameMode.TianrenDuo, 5 => GameMode.TianrenTrio, 5000010 => GameMode.EndlessTrial, _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(battleTid), $"未知 heyBox battleTid: {battleTid}") };

GameMode.name: ToHeyBoxBattleTid
GameMode.description: 把 GameMode 映射回 heyBox 数据源的 battleTid，用于查询 heybox/user/info 指定模式的段位与统计。
GameMode.body: return value switch { GameMode.RankSolo => 5000000, GameMode.RankDuo => 12, GameMode.RankTrio => 5000001, GameMode.MatchSolo => 6, GameMode.MatchDuo => 9, GameMode.MatchTrio => 7, GameMode.TianrenSolo => 4, GameMode.TianrenDuo => 13, GameMode.TianrenTrio => 5, GameMode.EndlessTrial => 5000010, _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value)) };

GameMode.name: ToBattleApiCode
GameMode.description: 把 GameMode 映射为 miniProgram 对局历史 API 编码（battleApiCode）。用于把 heyBox 归一化到与 miniProgram 一致的编码，供 VM 层统一消费。
GameMode.returns: 对应的 battleApiCode，无对应时抛异常
GameMode.body: return value switch { GameMode.RankSolo => 1, GameMode.RankDuo => 12, GameMode.RankTrio => 2, GameMode.MatchSolo => 6, GameMode.MatchDuo => 9, GameMode.MatchTrio => 7, GameMode.TianrenSolo => 4, GameMode.TianrenDuo => 13, GameMode.TianrenTrio => 5, _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value)) };
